title: The Softmax Constraint Map
description: Constraint cost per Transformer operation in a ZK circuit — without and with lookup arguments. Softmax (275→30), LayerNorm (150→20), and GELU (400→40) dominate the budget until Lasso/LogUp replace in-circuit transcendental approximations with table lookups. Tap a row to inspect.
controls: both states always visible: orange = no lookups, cyan = with lookups

dataSource.label: ZK-DeepSeek arXiv:2511.19902; ezkl benchmarks; Haböck LogUp 2022/1530; Setty & Lee Lasso 2023/1216
